answer: Each agent claims one copper plot at 800 credits, locking a 100-credit bond. A cedar stake posts the price for any buyer: low prices invite buyouts, high prices bleed tax. Each epoch the owner pays 6 percent, 48 credits, as Harberger tax. A spiral of fakes fails: 1,000 puppets burn 48,000 per epoch against a 40,000 share, plus 100,000 locked. Rented stakes get bought out at their low price. Honest agents pay 48 per epoch and keep plot and share.
